content: Andowoon 29-33
Yekob Leban Yaa Wonoon
Kwanekore, Yekob kuu angkon wenene kangkadan yi karub yi ambibkin yaa aomnoon.

Aomnekore, wedangka wedmoon kuu okdobon kuyaambed sibi nimingke dobaraiwa nimingke dobaraiwa nimingke dobaraiwa ayoobmim kamimamiib kuu menebe dibiriwen, amborom kuu okdobon kuyaambed sibi kuu ok bangkandiiwe animamiib kowe. Okdobon animari dabunimamiib ye bot kuu darewoob.

Kwane sibi nimingke dobiriwen korem kuu menebe nedbaiwe sibi ooniwendanbed okdobon animari bot darewoob kuu kanangkanekorib ok yuungke bangkandimamiib. Bangkandekorib, angkon ika bot kuu kande okdobon anim ari kebenimamiib.
Yekobbed sibi ooniwendan yaa kaamondoon “Nangkodmia! Yiib kambong kuu kane?” andoone yimbed man yedmiwen “Nub kambong kuu Haran.” andiiwe,
yembed yi yaa yedmoon “Yiib kuu Nehor ye awo Leban kuu yiibkaadoo?” andoone, “Ee, ye kuu nubkaadaa.” andiwen.
Kwane Yekobbed yi yaa kaamondoon “Ye kuu amun dee?” andoone, yimbed yedmiwen “Ee, ye kuu amunmo doreen. Ye mungkan Reksel kuu sibi kee be menuun kei.” andiwen.
Andiiwe, yembed yedmoon “Wedmime. Kuu oobnonban, kuu aron angkaramo kowe, sibi kuu nedbi yaron kuu mokeed. Kwani kowe, ok bangkandekorib bewene kereek yemoon yaa wenebime.” andoon.

Kumban yimbed man yedmiwen “Nubbedmo kuu yiminban, sibi korem yoom yi oonidan korem yoom kuu mimyamo nedbaniiwe okdobon ari bot dabuniwen kuu nub korem kanangkonekorub kumbed ok kuu bangkandanuub.” andiwen.
Ye kwane yi yoom dorone dakmiiwe, Reksel kuu yu ambe ye sibiyiib benu muneen, amborom kuu yu kangkon sibi oonimamuun ye wonong kereen kowe.
Kwane Yekob kuu ye mom Leban ye dana Reksel wedmendekore, wene okdobon animari bot kebeniwen kuu kanangkanekore, ye mom ye sibi kuu ok yuungke bangkandoon.
Kwanekore, Yekob kuu Reksel yaa mandamuk kerunde ameng kamande kamoon.
Kwane yembed yu yaa yedmendoon “Ne kuu kub ambe ye karubkim, angkon ne kuu Rebeka yu dana.” andoone, yumbed kabaanmo wene yu ambe yedmeneen.

Yedmenuune ye yangkura yu mingki monoon Lebanbed wengamberekore, kirodmo wene wenganok wonoon. Wenene yembed nenkangkunekore mandamuk kerekore, yambiwoom nenwonoon. Kuyaambed Yekobbed weng korem kuu daanoon.
daanoone, Lebanbed yedmoon “Eb kuu ne umkan anam.” andoon. Kwane Yekob kuu ye yoom doriiwe, wood mimo kereen.
Yekobbed Lea Yoom Reksel Yoom Awadmoon
Lebanbed ye yaa yedmoon “Eb kuu ne karubkim kuned ne deme ogoodmo ambangkeeb kuu amunban. Ebbed yedmewe, eb dowaken deme ambangki ye kakman yaa kuu komo andaneeb?” andoon.
Leban kuu nimadana koyu ayoowiib, angkaan yu aningko kuu Lea, angkon nengkan yu aningko kuu Reksel.
Lea yu indob kuu wuud korobe wedmindeban, kumban Reksel kuu kerengandimbon.
Yekob kuu Reksel yaa awani inamen meenendekore yedmoon “Ne kuu weeb ediib eb deme ambangkako eb dana nengkan Reksel kuu ne yaa domowe.” andoon.
Andoone, Lebanbed yedmoon “Eb yaa kabdaniin kumbed amun, karub maa yaa koni kuu amunban kowe, neyiib yaa keya dobere.” andoon.
Andoone, Yekob kuu weeb ediib Leban ye deme ambangkoon, Reksel awani ye dowad. Kumban ye dowaken kuu Reksel yaa meenendoon kowe aron doboobban ande meenoon.
Kwane, Yekobbed Leban yaa yedmoon “Weeb ediib dowan kereen kowe, Reksel kuu kawebko awana.” andoone,
Lebanbed orok ongmoone karub korem kuyaom doriib kuu nedbiiwa aniwen,
kumban miriknoone ye dana angkaan Lea nenwene Yekob yaa domonenekore, angkon ye deme wonong Silpa kuu ye dana angkaan yaa yu deme ambangki yeman kondekore, Yekob kuu Lea yoom dangiwena,

amkimo kerune, Yekob kuu yaro wedme binangkoon, “Ii, Lea kii!” ande meene wedmekore, Leban yaa wene yedmoon “Ne yaa kee komarewa kerewen? Ne kuu Reksel yu dowad eb deme ambangkaan, komandewed ne yaa nemengkawewen?” andoone,
Lebanbed neman yedmoon “Nengkandin awanekore angkaan yoman awani kuu nub ambibkin keyaom ma kwanimokban
kowe, ne mungkan kee yu awani ye dowad orok yaron ediib dobereewo dowan keruka, angkon Reksel kuu kabdubko awanekoreb, angkon ika weeb ediib ne deme ambangke.” andoon.
Andoone, Yekobbed yedmoon “Ee kwananiin.” andoon. Kowe, Yekob kuu Lea yoom orok yaron ediib doberekoriwe, Lebanbed ye dana nengkan Reksel konoone ye wonong keroon.
Angkon Lebanbed ye deme wonong Bilha kuu ye dana Reksel yaa yu deme ambangki yeman kondoon.
Reksel konoone, Yekob kuu yu yoom dangiwen. Ye kuu Reksel yaamo dowaken darewoob kerundekore, Lea kuu dowakenban kerundoon. Kwanekore, angkon weeb ediib Leban ye deme ambangkoon.
Yekob Ye Meed
Kuu ye weeb ediib kuyaombed, Yariman Godbed wedmoone Lea yaa kuu Yekob ye dowakenban keroon kowe, Godbed yu dana wooni ye kiwaan nandoon, kumban Reksel kuu kurong kereen.

Lea kuu oyoomiib kerekoru, dana mingki wooneen. Woonekoru, yumbed yedmeen “Yariman Godbed ne yaa dabab kandaan kuu wedmewoon kowe, anam ne ambimbed ne yaa dowaken keraneen.” andekoru, dana yaningko Ruben
ande koween.

Amaan angkon ika oyoomiib kerekoru, dana mingki wooneen. Woonekoru, yumbed yedmeen “Yariman Godbed wengamboroon ne yaa kuu ne ambimbed meenewindo kowe, Godbed dana kee kawoon.” andekoru, dana yaningko Simion
ande koween.

Amaan angkon ika oyoomiib kerekoru, dana mingki wooneen. Woonekoru, yumbed yedmeen “Kibikee, ne ambimbed ne yaa yubudkawaneen, amborom kuu nembed ye karub dana ayoobmim baan kowe.” andekoru, dana yaningko Livai
ande koween.
Amaan angkon ika oyoomiib kerekoru, dana mingki wooneen. Woonekoru, yumbed yedmeen “Kibikee, Yariman God yaningko kankoonaan.” andekoru, dana yaningko Yuda
ande koween. Yoman, Lea kuu ika kurong kereen.

footnotes.text: Ruben yaningko ye weng id kuu “Dabab Kandaane Wedmewoon”.
Simion yaningko ye weng id kuu “Wengamboroon”.
Livai yaningko ye weng id kuu “Yubudkani”.
Yuda yaningko ye weng id kuu “Aningko Kankooni”.
